text.aria-label: Title text 'G21: every input channel of one training window w, its injected member w+, and its raised-sky member w^c (grey: hidden span; dotted: transfer edges; ticks: half-hours with an injection)'

g.text: G21: every input channel of one training window w, its injected member w+, and its raised-sky member w^c (grey: hidden span; dotted: transfer edges; ticks: half-hours with an injection)

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'The extra injection comes from a sibling of source S2 (a published farm, never a metered one). The window comes from a segment with a BSP meter, so the BSP step is not flat.'
text.tspan: The extra injection comes from a sibling of source S2 (a published farm, never a metered one).
The window comes from a segment with a BSP meter, so the BSP step is not flat.
